instance_description:
Setting: 2026 mobility records for a Portland-based independent museum courier who travels with loaned artwork between museums, airports, rail stations, hotels, customs offices, and secure loading areas.
Scope: Covers local transit to collection sites, escorted flight and train trips, hotel transfers, timed handoffs, travel documents, courier-kit packing, layover planning, and delay responses.
Resources: Personal records, working notes, and app history provide the background for recurring activities within this scope.
Exclusions: No artwork valuation, conservation decisions, employer accounting, cargo shipping without the traveler, vehicle maintenance, or scenario-specific bookings and messages.
personal_description:
Identity: Luca Imre Batal is an independent fine-art courier living in Portland, Oregon.
Responsibilities: He reaches museums, airports, rail terminals, hotels, customs desks, and secure receiving areas on schedule while personally accompanying assigned loan materials.
Authority: Luca may choose his own routes, buy fares, adjust lodging or passenger reservations, organize personal travel documents, and prepare courier travel notes.
Restrictions: He does not authenticate artworks, negotiate loan contracts, disclose collection-sensitive details, book travel for other couriers, maintain vehicles, or perform unrelated household tasks.
